mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals economic weakness and potential recession, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 300) combined with insufficient monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS < 5.0%) signals persistent inflation without adequate policy response, increasing recession risk and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, strong housing starts (HOUST > 1400) signal robust consumer demand and economic momentum, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1400 during late-cycle expansions, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST > 1450) indicate strong residential construction activity and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1450, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high industrial production index (INDPRO > 102.0) signals robust manufacturing output and economic expansion, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 102.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, elevated federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) signal aggressive policy to combat inflation, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0% during monetary tightening cycles, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS > 100k) coupled with declining unemployment (UNRATE < 3.6%) signals a tight labor market and robust economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 100k and UNRATE falls below 3.6%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
